accelerometer_odr.docs:
**string**: The output data rate of the accelerometer. One of `12_5HZ`, `25HZ`, `50HZ`, `100HZ`, `200HZ`, `400HZ`, `800HZ`, `1600HZ`. Defaults to `100HZ`.

*See also: [BMI270 Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/bmi270#configuration-variables)*

accelerometer_range.docs:
**string**: The full-scale range of the accelerometer. One of `2G`, `4G`, `8G`, `16G`. Defaults to `4G`.

*See also: [BMI270 Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/bmi270#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x68`. The BMI270 supports `0x68` (SDO to GND) and `0x69` (SDO to VDDIO).

*See also: [BMI270 Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/bmi270#configuration-variables)*

gyroscope_odr.docs:
**string**: The output data rate of the gyroscope. One of `25HZ`, `50HZ`, `100HZ`, `200HZ`, `400HZ`, `800HZ`, `1600HZ`, `3200HZ`. Defaults to `200HZ`.

*See also: [BMI270 Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/bmi270#configuration-variables)*

gyroscope_range.docs:
**string**: The full-scale range of the gyroscope. One of `125DPS`, `250DPS`, `500DPS`, `1000DPS`, `2000DPS`. Defaults to `2000DPS`.

*See also: [BMI270 Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/bmi270#configuration-variables)*

type.docs:
**string**: Must be set to `temperature`, or simply omitted.

*See also: [BMI270 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bmi270#configuration-variables)*
